en.ammaar-muslim: 1. [1/88] Tahdhib al-Ahkam: Via his chain from al-Saffar from Muhammad b. al-Husayn b. Abi al-Khattab from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Abi Nasr from Hammad b. Uthman from Zurara from Abi Ja’far عليه السلام

in regards His words Mighty and Majestic: “as ruled by two just men among you” [5:95] – the just man is the messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله and the Imam after him – he rules on it whilst being just, so if you know how the messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله ruled and the Imam then it is enough for you and do not inquire beyond that.
